title: CMOS Y2K rollover
change_summary: In `time_init()`, treat CMOS `tm_year < 70` as `20yy` by adding 100 before calling `kernel_mktime()`.

title: Syscall wrappers for modern GCC
change_summary: Replace the `_syscall0()` macro definitions for `fork`, `pause`, `setup` and `sync` with explicit `int $0x80` inline wrappers. Modern GCC rejects the `static` redeclaration after the non-static prototypes in `unistd.h`.

title: VGA 80×50 text mode
change_summary: Switch to the BIOS 8×8 font at boot so `con_init()` initializes 50 rows instead of 25. Export `lines` and `attr` for assembly helpers. Add `copy_screen`, `copy_screen_down` and `clear_screen` helpers with proper clobbers and memory barriers.

title: Serial UART 115200 baud
change_summary: Change UART divisor from `0x30` (2400 bps) to `0x01` (115200 bps) and add `serial_console_write()` for polled COM1 output.

title: Console output duplication removal
change_summary: Remove the duplicate printk path that sent every byte through both `serial_puts` and `tty_write` → `con_write` → `serial_console_write`.

title: CP437 / extended VGA glyph filter
change_summary: Relax `con_write()` filter from bytes 32–126 to allow extended glyphs such as `∞` (0xEC), box-drawing characters and math symbols.

title: Buffer-cache free-list walk
change_summary: Rewrite the free-list loop in `getblk()` to avoid the `while (tmp != free_list || (tmp=NULL))` idiom. Add null guard in `remove_from_hash_queue()`.

title: ATA PIO read helper and port macros
change_summary: Add `read_abs_hd()` for polled two-sector reads, add memory clobbers to `port_read`/`port_write`, and add parentheses to the request sorting macro.

title: Colored diagnostic printk
change_summary: Add ANSI color to partition-table and `sys_setup` messages.

title: `PIPE_HEAD` increment macro
change_summary: Replace inline-assembly `INC_PIPE` macro with a pure C expression.

title: Filesystem patches for Minix v1 root image
change_summary: Adjustments in `fs/super.c`, `fs/open.c`, `fs/exec.c`, `fs/stat.c`, `fs/namei.c`, `fs/char_dev.c`, `fs/pipe.c`, `fs/read_write.c`, `fs/tty_ioctl.c`, `fs/block_dev.c` to support the generated Minix v1 root image and device nodes.

title: Memory-management compatibility
change_summary: Adjustments in `mm/memory.c` and `mm/page.s` for modern GCC inline-assembly constraints and page-table handling.

title: Kernel assembly clobbers and constraints
change_summary: Update inline assembly in `kernel/asm.s`, `kernel/system_call.s`, `kernel/keyboard.s`, `kernel/rs_io.s` for modern as/GCC constraints.

title: Include header adjustments
change_summary: Minor updates to `include/linux/*.h`, `include/asm/*.h`, `include/string.h`, `include/ctype.h`, `include/sys/wait.h` for modern toolchain compatibility and BBP integration.

title: `lib/open.c` adjustment
change_summary: Update `lib/open.c` for modern calling convention and BBP compatibility.

title: Validated experience environment bridge
change_summary: Read the validated BBP experience selector in `init` and pass the matching `HOME` plus `EXPERIENCE` values to the shell.
